title: Pelvic Pain - OB/GYN
hpi_narrative: A 35-year-old female presents with pelvic pain. Onset is acute, character is severe and persistent, associated symptoms include none, pertinent negatives are no known allergies or current medications. The single clinical question this case forces you to answer is: What is the cause of the patient's pelvic pain?

genitalia.finding: This is important to do since the source of the patient's pain is coming from the pelvic area.

abdomen.finding: Abdominal pathology can present as pelvic pain. An example of this is inflammatory bowel disease.

stacks.label: General Appearance
stacks.finding: Patient having severe pain – appropriate to look at patient to help guide diagnosis.

stacks.label: Chest / Lungs
stacks.finding: Important to rule out any lung issues such as metastatic disease.
